summary: Indeterminate progress tasks (total=None) are implemented in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst and tests/test_progress.py. Summary of the change: ProgressBar pulses when total is None and percentage_completed returns None; the new public TaskProgressColumn (a TextColumn subclass) replaces the percentage text column in get_default_columns and the track helper; TimeRemainingColumn, TotalFileSizeColumn, MofNCompleteColumn and DownloadColumn have unknown-total branches; Task.remaining and time_remaining return None for an unknown total; update and advance only set finished_time/finished_speed when the total is known; docs and docstrings describe the None behavior. Tests: tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (54 tests; baseline was 43). New tests cover the blank, "?", and binary/decimal unit outputs, the pinned pulse render for an unknown-total task, the standalone bar, and the Task behavior. Not verified: black is not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand; tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the venv lacks the attr package; the full suite has 13 failures in card, markdown, syntax and traceback tests that also fail on a clean HEAD checkout. Nothing was committed.
